title: The gym terms changed on 14 Nov, but owners were never asked to accept them again
what: The terms page says that before a new version applies, MettleUp tells the owner in the admin app and asks them to accept it again. On 14 Nov a new section for gyms was added (the gym is responsible for the ready-made plans it sends), and the page now says last updated 18 Nov. The admin app still asks only for the 10 Nov version, so no owner who accepted on 10 Nov is asked again, and Settings keeps saying they accepted the terms (version 10 Nov).
expected: Each change that touches gyms gets a new version, so every owner sees the terms card once more and accepts it; or the page does not promise a new acceptance.
who: every gym owner who accepted the 10 Nov terms
fix_line: Raise the terms version for the 14 Nov change so owners are asked once more

title: In Hinglish, Staff & sign-in, the PIN sheets, the terms card, Put your gym online and every sign-in error stay in English
what: An owner who picks Hinglish gets the sign-in page and Create my gym in Hinglish. But every error on those same pages (wrong PIN, too many tries, code failed, no internet) is in English. After sign-in, the Choose a new PIN sheet, Set my PIN, the terms card asked once, Put your gym online, and almost all of Staff & sign-in (the You card, Make sign-in code, Sign out, Remove, every confirm box and the sign-in code sheet) are English. Only the Add a person button, the name and number boxes and a few pills switch.
expected: Every line on these screens, errors included, follows the language picked, or the language switch says which screens are Hinglish so far.
who: owners and desk staff who picked Hinglish
how_often: every wrong PIN or code, and every visit to Staff & sign-in
fix_line: Put these lines and the error words through the language switch and add their Hinglish

title: Once WhatsApp number checks are required, 'Put gym online' fails and tells the owner to ask for a WhatsApp code it cannot send
what: A gym kept only in a browser goes online from the 'Put your gym online' card. That card makes the online gym without any number check, PIN or terms tick. The server has a switch that, when on, refuses any new gym without a WhatsApp number check. Then the card can only say 'We could not check your mobile number. Ask for a new code on WhatsApp and try again.' and the card has no button to get a code. The owner is stuck, and is told 'Nothing in this browser was lost' each time.
expected: The card checks the number by WhatsApp the same way Create my gym does, or the words say what to do instead.
who: owners whose gym is kept only in this browser
how_often: every try, once the number check switch is on (off today)
fix_line: Add the WhatsApp number check to Put your gym online before the switch goes on

title: A long job name on Staff & sign-in runs past the person's box on a phone
what: A staff member's job (for example 'Manager') shows as a small pill next to their name. A job can be up to 40 letters, and the pill never breaks onto a second line. At 320 to 390 px wide the box for each person is only about 200 to 280 px inside, so a long job sticks out past the box and can push the page sideways.
expected: A long job wraps or is cut with dots inside the box.
who: owners who type a long job name
how_often: when a job is longer than about 25 letters
fix_line: Let the job pill wrap or shorten with dots

items.reason: no app icon, badge, manifest or share image is referenced in sign-in or data code; only an inline WhatsApp mark and a QR drawn on the page
